- **GPT-4o series**: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini (various dated versions)
- **o-series**: o1, o1-pro, o3, o3-mini, o3-pro, o3-deep-research, o4-mini, o4-mini-deep-research
- **GPT-Realtime**: GPT-Realtime-2.1

## **Google** (via `google-generative-ai`)

- **Gemma 4**: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT, Gemma 4 31B IT

## **Groq** (via `openai-completions`)
- Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 4 Scout 17B 16E
- GPT OSS 20B, GPT OSS 120B, GPT OSS Safeguard 20B
- Qwen3-32B

## **Together** (via `openai-completions`)
- MiniMax-M2.7, MiniMax-M3
- Qwen 2.5/3.5/3.6/3.7 series
- DeepSeek V4 Pro
- Kimi K2.6, K2.7 Code
- Gemma 4 31B
- GPT OSS 20B, 120B
- Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, Inkling, GLM-5.2

## **Fireworks** (via `anthropic-messages` / `openai-completions`)
- DeepSeek V4 Flash, V4 Pro
- GLM 5.1, 5.2
- GPT OSS 20B, 120B
- Kimi K2.6, K2.7 Code
- MiniMax-M2.7, M3
- Qwen 3.7 Plus

## **OpenRouter**
- A large aggregation of models from many providers (too many to list individually)
